name: Desk Cable Grommet
description: A sleeve that lines a hole through a desk, with a flange over the desk top, and a cap that drops into it. Round or square holes; the cap has a cable slot, flexible brush fingers, a solid blank or an open trim ring, with optional inlaid text. One clearance parameter sets both joints. Sleeve and cap print side by side without supports.
source: inspired by Printables Parametric Cable Grommet
